answer: A bonded reputation trellis resists sybils: joining requires locking a refundable bond larger than one epoch reward, and the bond cannot be split across clones without weakening each copy. Agents climb only through peer-verified useful work, and a bridge to higher limits opens only after consistent behaviour. Misbehaviour slashes the bond and erases the climb, so each fake identity must pay the full bond and start over. Without that history an account is hollow: it exists but cannot vote, attest, or claim rewards.
